1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif at comfortable sizes with ample line height and whitespace, though letter spacing is default rather than notably generous.

2.why: All instructions are sentence-case with no italics and no paragraph longer than two lines; the only all-caps text is the 'NORTHSTAR BANK' brand header, which is not an instruction.

3.why: Content sits in a single narrow centred column with large text and simple stacking that would fit a phone viewport, and nothing overlaps or overflows at the captured width.

4.why: Every instruction is a single plain sentence, e.g. 'Enter the delivered six-digit code.' and 'Store these codes somewhere safe.'

5.why: Only the recovery-code field shows an example format (placeholder 'ABCDE-FGHIJ'); the email, phone, verification-code and authenticator-code inputs show no example of expected input.

6.why: The longest text the user must read to proceed is a two-line sentence; the verbose Logs panel is supplementary test output, not required reading.

7.why: Secrets and codes are rendered as ordinary selectable text, but there is no copy button or bulk-copy affordance, so the designed path is manual transcription of the secret and hand-typing of codes.

8.why: No QR code or otpauth link/button is offered at any point; step 4 presents only a manual secret string for authenticator setup.

9.why: Inputs are bare text fields with no visible autocomplete or one-time-code hints and no password field for a password manager to integrate with, so autofill support is not evident.

10.why: Each screen has a bold heading naming the step and a full-width blue primary button, though the dashboard shows two equally prominent blue buttons which slightly dilutes the single primary action.

11.why: Most screens ask for one action, but the authenticator screen combines 'Generate secret' and 'Confirm', and the dashboard presents verify, regenerate and log out together.

12.why: Success states plainly report outcomes ('Recovery code accepted. Remaining unused codes: 7.', 'Your authenticator is now enrolled.'), but the error banner gives no explanation of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The user can regenerate the secret and recovery codes and retry after the failed request without any visible lockout, but there are no reveal/hide toggles for codes.

14.why: The only observed error, 'We could not complete that request.', is blame-free but states neither the specific problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: No reading deadline or session countdown is shown, but the authenticator code explicitly expires at a stated clock time (19:55:30), a standard short TOTP window rather than generous entry time.
